How to find your size

All our printed apparel is a unisex fit. Garment measurements are taken flat, in centimetres (width = armpit to armpit, length = shoulder to hem).

Unisex T-Shirt (soft combed cotton)

Size Chest width (flat) Body length
S 45.7 cm 69.9 cm
M 50.8 cm 72.4 cm
L 55.9 cm 74.9 cm
XL 61 cm 77.5 cm
2XL 66 cm 80 cm

Tip: the chest measurement is the garment laid flat — double it for the full circumference.

Hoodies

Our hoodies run roomy and boxy — a classic streetwear fit. If you normally wear a unisex tee in size M, the hoodie in M will fit comfortably over layers. When in doubt between two sizes, choose the smaller one for a fitted look and the larger for layering over a waistcoat or coat.

Corsets & gear

Corsets and gear items list their own size chart on each product page (waist reduction-based sizing). Check the individual product for details.

Measuring yourself

Lay one of your own well-fitting t-shirts flat and measure armpit-to-armpit and shoulder-to-hem — then match against the table above. Between sizes? Size up for a relaxed look, or pick your exact match for a fitted silhouette.

Questions?

If you are between sizes or unsure about a costume build, reach us via the contact page — include your measurements and we will recommend a size.

title.rendered: Steampunk Costumes: DIY Guides, Ideas & Gear

content.rendered:
Steampunk costumes mix Victorian fashion with brass, gears and a touch of mad science. Whether you want to build your first outfit from thrift-store finds or buy ready-made gear before a convention, this is the hub for everything Steamgears has published on DIY steampunk costumes, cosplay and accessories.

Start here: your first steampunk costume

New to the genre? Read Steampunk Cosplay for Beginners — it explains the three core layers (base, Victorian silhouette, gear) and how to get a complete look on a small budget. Then follow our step-by-step build: How to Make a Steampunk Costume, photo-illustrated from first cut to final fit.

Build it, buy it, or accessorise it

  • Build it yourself: our full costume guide covers jackets, waistcoats, belts and buckles you can make at home.
  • Buy ready-made gear: browse the Steamgears shop — artist-series t-shirts, hoodies and costume gear printed on demand.
  • Accessorise the look: 25+ steampunk accessories — goggles, watches, bracers and bags that finish any outfit.

Every Steamgears costume guide

  • Steampunk Cosplay for Beginners — your first outfit, explained layer by layer.
  • How to Make a Steampunk Costume — the complete DIY build.
  • DIY Steampunk Goggles — build a pair in 30 minutes.
  • Steampunk Costume Ideas — airship captain, inventor, explorer and more.
  • Steampunk Cosplay on a Budget — the $40 full-outfit formula.
  • Steampunk Accessories — the finishing touches.

Shop steampunk gear by category

  • Steampunk T-Shirts — original artist designs, printed on demand.
  • Steampunk Hoodies — heavyweight prints for cold workshops.
  • Steampunk Goggles — aviator and welding styles for costumes.
  • Corsets & Clothing — Victorian silhouettes ready to wear.
  • Steampunk Accessories — hats, bags and props.

Steampunk costume FAQ

What do I need for a basic steampunk costume?

Three layers: a neutral base, one Victorian silhouette piece (waistcoat, corset or long skirt) and gear — goggles, a pocket watch, gloves or a hat. Our beginner guide lists exact items.

Can I build a steampunk costume cheaply?

Yes. The $40 outfit formula shows which pieces to buy, which to thrift and which to build.

Are goggles necessary?

No, but they are the fastest way to signal “steampunk”. Build your own with the DIY goggles guide.

Comments

Suggested text: When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.

An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.

Media

Suggested text: If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.

Cookies

Suggested text: If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.

If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.

When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select "Remember Me", your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.

If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.

Embedded content from other websites

Suggested text: Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.

These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.

Who we share your data with

Suggested text: If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.

How long we retain your data

Suggested text: If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.

For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.

What rights you have over your data

Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.

Where your data is sent

14-day right of withdrawal (EU consumers)

If you order as a consumer from the EU, you have the right to cancel your order within 14 days of receiving the goods – no reason needed. To use this right, email cpaleadsis@gmail.com with your order number and a clear statement that you wish to cancel.

How to return an item

Contact us first at the email above – we will send you return instructions and the correct return address, as items ship from different warehouses. Please do not send items back without contacting us. Return shipping is paid by the customer unless the item is faulty or wrong.

Items should be unused and in original packaging when returned. You are only liable for any loss of value caused by handling beyond what is necessary to check the item.

Refunds

Once we have received the returned item (or proof of shipment), we refund the purchase price including standard shipping costs within 14 days, using the same payment method you used for the order.

Exceptions

For hygiene reasons, clothing worn in direct contact with the skin (including corsets with intimate contact areas) cannot be returned if the hygiene seal is removed – unless the item is faulty.

Faulty or wrong items

If you receive a damaged, faulty or wrong item, contact us within a reasonable time with photos and your order number. We will send a replacement or refund – your statutory rights under Danish consumer law (2-year complaint right on manufacturing defects) apply.

Questions

Any question about an order? Email cpaleadsis@gmail.com – we reply within 2-3 business days.

This privacy policy explains what data Steamgears (https://steamgears.eu) collects, why we collect it, and what rights you have. The data controller is the Steamgears team. Reach us at cpaleadsis@gmail.com for any privacy question.

What data we collect

  • Shop data: when you order in our webshop we collect your name, email address, shipping address and order details, so we can deliver your order and handle returns.
  • Technical data: IP address, browser type and pages visited are logged by our hosting provider for security and statistics.
  • Analytics data: we use Google Analytics 4 (via Google Tag Manager) to understand how the site is used. Google may store data outside the EU.
  • Advertising cookies: we use Google AdSense to show ads. Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites.

Cookies and advertising

Google's use of advertising cookies (including the DoubleClick cookie) enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visit to our site and/or other sites on the internet. You may opt out of personalised advertising at Google Ads Settings, or opt out of third-party vendor cookies at aboutads.info.

Where required (including in the EU/EEA), we ask for your consent before setting non-essential cookies, and you can change or withdraw consent at any time via the cookie banner.

Payment processing

Payments in our shop are handled by external payment providers (such as Stripe, Klarna or MobilePay). We do not store your card details; the payment provider processes them under its own privacy policy.

Legal basis and your rights (GDPR)

We process data on the basis of consent, contract (orders) and legitimate interest (security and statistics). You have the right to access, rectify or erase your personal data, to object to processing, and to data portability. You can also complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet).

Data retention and security

Order data is kept as long as required by accounting rules; analytics data is kept according to Google's default retention. The site is served over HTTPS. We store as little data as possible.

Changes and contact

We may update this policy as the site evolves. The latest version is always on this page. Questions? Email cpaleadsis@gmail.com.

Steamgears is a workshop for anyone who wants to build steampunk costumes with their own hands – and a small shop for the gear that finishes the look.

<

What we do

We publish step-by-step DIY steampunk costume guides: goggles, corsets, jackets, props and full outfits built from thrift-store finds, foam, leather, brass paint and patience. Every guide is written to be buildable on a kitchen table with common tools – no workshop required.

  • DIY guides – detailed build walkthroughs with materials lists
  • Budget builds – steampunk style without the collector price tag
  • Gallery – real convention looks for inspiration
  • The shop – ready-made steampunk gear when you would rather buy than build

Why steampunk?

Steampunk is the rare cosplay genre where the rule is: if it looks like it could run on steam, it belongs. Brass, leather, clockwork and a story. You do not need to be a master craftsman to make something you are proud to wear – you need a plan and a Saturday afternoon.

Have a build you want us to cover, or a question about a guide? Head over to the contact page – we read everything.

<

– The Steamgears crew
